Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the intro on the platform last week. We're preparing our vendor onboarding packet and need to confirm a couple of operational items before we submit the vendor form and PO from our side. Key questions: 

- Our AP closes the first business day of each month; our standard supplier terms are Net 45 to align with our monthly cycle. Can Redwood accept Net 45 for initial purchases?
- If Net 45 is acceptable, do you support an early-pay discount (we typically request 0.5% if we pay within 10 days)? If Redwood prefers Net 30, can you outline any flexibility or early-pay tiers?

I'll attach the CloudEdge vendor form in my next message. We plan to issue an initial PO for reserved capacity (approx $85k) once the vendor profile is created. Please let me know what you need from procurement and finance to set this up.

Thanks,

Appreciate the clear heads-up. Looping in Karthik (Finance lead) and Laura (Legal / vendor intake) so we can close this out quickly. Attached is our vendor PO template and the onboarding checklist — please send the completed vendor form and your PO when ready.

Quick answers / asks from our side:

- We are open to early-pay discounts. To help Karthik evaluate, can you confirm your expected payment trigger (invoice receipt vs. invoice date) and whether CloudEdge can commit an ACH or wire within the early-pay window?

Action items:
1) Sophia: upload completed CloudEdge_VendorForm.pdf and send PO referencing Redwood's vendor legal name (Redwood Inference, Inc.).
2) Karthik/Laura: confirm whether Net 45 is approvable and propose early-pay %/window that balances Redwood unit economics.

Hi team —

Thanks Marissa + Sophia. A couple of notes from Finance after a quick review of the ask and the expected spend: 

- Redwood's default is Net 30 (invoice date). We can approve Net 45 for CloudEdge on an exceptions basis. Approval conditions: signed PO referencing our customer master (we need PO number), vendor onboarding complete, and invoice delivery to invoices@redwood.com.
- Regarding early-pay discounts: we can offer an early-pay discount tier if CloudEdge can process payment within a defined window. Our recommendation (to preserve margin while offering value): 0.75% discount if payment is posted within 15 days of invoice date. 0.5% for payment within 10 days would be acceptable but tighter for our treasury processes.
- Operational ask: if CloudEdge wants Net 45 with an early-pay option, please indicate in the PO the requested default term (Net 45) and the early-pay clause (e.g., \"1.0% discount if paid within 10 days\" — we will adjust to 0.75% and confirm in the vendor onboarding note).

I'll draft the exception approval once we receive the completed vendor form and a sample PO. Laura, please flag any legal notes (contractual language) we should include for the early-pay clause.

Karthik
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
